title: findsylls: A Language-Agnostic Toolkit for Syllable-Level Speech Tokenization and Embedding
description: findsylls is a modular, language-agnostic Python toolkit for unsupervised syllable-level speech segmentation, embedding extraction, and multi-granular evaluation. It unifies classical envelope-based detectors (e.g. spectral band subtraction, theta oscillator) and end-to-end self-supervised syllabifiers (e.g. Sylber, VG-HuBERT) under a common interface, allowing their components to be recombined for controlled comparisons of representations, algorithms, and token rates.
